tasks.on_failure: Stop broad acceptance expansion if acquisition, oracle independence, history, action binding or current-player correlation fails. Retain the negative receipt, isolate the smallest evidence-glue or reproduced required-runtime fix, then rerun this pilot with new IDs.

session_packs.proof: Exact action/callback, contiguous required World output/history, caller-state and resources. Native UI layout uses explicit semantic policy checks. A pack is a scheduling candidate, not automatic requirement coverage.

scope_routes.blocking_condition: Any required natural alternate allocation/publication/writer/lifetime path in the claimed player.
scope_routes.close_when: Recover the required chain or justify a precise caller/configuration boundary with evidence. The opt-in original allocation repair and native padded storage do not recover historical ownership or prove global unreachability.

scope_routes.blocking_condition: A claim includes enabled-padding fullscreen or its required presentation transition.
scope_routes.close_when: Distinguish original exclusive/padded failures from Qt presentation and native padding; independently validate required output and lifetime. Windowed success and context fixtures do not close the configuration.

scope_routes.blocking_condition: Unresolved raw readers, self/keyed GPU copies, aliases/writers or large fills are required by the claimed journeys.
scope_routes.close_when: Establish the actual required caller and independently check its output/side effects, or document a precise justified boundary. No positive count is manufactured; zero observations are not global absence.

scope_routes.blocking_condition: Complete native/live equality depends on the history preceding the selected late capture interval.
scope_routes.close_when: Recover and produce the required owned history. Same-zero-base equality and original-before diagnostics retain their distinct results; establish relevance to the resident player before calling this a current player defect.

scope_routes.blocking_condition: Final supported campaign/map/save/duration claims have not been explicitly bounded.
scope_routes.close_when: Name the supported domain and bounded execution profiles without dropping any of the fourteen journeys or twenty-one operations. Include actual later-map progression and both results; two Quick Battle maps and twelve minutes do not establish arbitrary maps/saves/duration.

scope_routes.blocking_condition: A required original screen helper/vtable/callback lifetime or route remains unresolved beneath the retained coordinator.
scope_routes.close_when: Account for required Main/Realm/World/Report routing, populated resource ownership and failure/retirement effects within the declared supplier boundary. Local provider fixtures do not automatically recover the real transition router.

scope_routes.blocking_condition: A claimed required game path produces live RGB555 or RGB555 sprite/effect output.
scope_routes.close_when: Establish requiredness and validate the full required production/ingestion/drawing path, or justify an exact supported-format boundary. Existing offline colour-only RGB555 proof is not live support; current RGB565 admission does not prove format1 unreachable.

scope_routes.blocking_condition: A claim includes legacy physical-driver identity, Windows exceptional behavior or physical device-loss/reset equivalence.
scope_routes.close_when: Supply appropriate physical/platform evidence or name an exact justified bounded Wine/native-provider claim. No unavailable Win98/ME host or synthetic fault is relabeled passed; required provider semantics remain open.

product_choices.recommendation: Begin with explicitly named finite inputs and bounded profiles covering every existing journey, actual later progression and both battle results. Claim only the domain supported by execution; propose broader promises with their cost.
product_choices.ask_user_when: The desired release promise exceeds the demonstrated finite domain or materially changes the existing target. Technical selection, capture and validation are engineering work.

product_choices.topic: Additional fullscreen, RGB555 or physical/legacy-platform promises
product_choices.recommendation: Use the existing reviewed strict-player target. Investigate whether any such route is already required by its journeys; never silently exclude it. Treat extra platform/format/presentation promises as an explicit expansion proposal.
product_choices.ask_user_when: A concrete expanded support promise is requested or engineering finds a conflict requiring a change to the existing target. Supply the boundary, evidence, consequence and recommendation first.

evidence_contract.storage: SQLite via coverage_evidence.write_report; raw retention is bounded and pinned; no new expanded research JSON reports.
evidence_contract.source_binding: Exact compiled-source/binary/asset/input closure and current applicability; historical IDs and hashes stay immutable.
evidence_contract.acceptance: All14journeys/47leaves/21operations/10gates for both target configurations with justified per-requirement reuse. Required original callbacks, independent output/history, native UI policy semantics, side effects/returns, input/media, response/progress/resources and normal/fault outcomes remain explicit.
evidence_contract.invalidation: A source/configuration/input change invalidates its affected evidence claims; review dependency/consumer scope before rerun. Never rewrite historical evidence or assume unrelated subsystems need revalidation.

positive_execution_admission.condition: Establish an actual independently validated current public-player receipt and its collector-specific admission at the pilot; EP10 joins adequate current evidence and EP11 records separate decisions. This opening producer verifies and stores candidates; it cannot certify acceptance.

first_work.activity: Review current source witnesses and all28lead payloads/assertions; classify current recorded source bindings, map every requirement to its owner and seed an applicability review.
remaining: Bind the actual as-built player compiler/binary source closure.
Bind actual original/assets/save identities and concrete pilot/map/save selectors.
Name actual host/provider/display/media configuration for each execution and its bounded resource/output budget.
Review evidence adequacy/applicability per requirement, caller, configuration and reference boundary before reuse.
